name: @macroforge/deno-plugin
description: Deno-native macro expansion for projects that don't use Vite

exports.name: expand
exports.type: (code: tring,, filepath: tring,, options?: xpandOptions) => xpandResult
exports.description: Expand a single in-memory TypeScript source string. Looks up `macroforge.config.*` from `projectRoot` (or `Deno.cwd()`) on first call, caches the parsed config, and forwards every other concern to the Rust engine.

exports.name: expandFile
exports.description: Read a file from disk and expand it.

exports.name: loadRustTransformer
exports.description: Resolve and initialize the macroforge engine. The first call loads the binary from the project's `node_modules` (resolved via the project CWD) and registers the host-side callbacks the WASM build needs. Subsequent calls return the same instance.
